items.title: Shared prerequisite: exact complementary linear Gaussian noise

items.statement: Let E,F,G be finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces with their Borel sigma algebras. Let A:E->G and B:F->G be continuous linear maps such that ||A* t||^2+||B* t||^2=||t||^2 for every t in G. If X and Y have independent standard Gaussian laws in E and F, respectively, then AX+BY has exactly the standard Gaussian law in G. Either map may be singular; dimensions may be zero.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel spaces E,F,G.
Continuous linear maps A:E->G and B:F->G.
Adjoint squared-norm balance for every t in G.
Actual independent input law stdGaussian(E) prod stdGaussian(F).

obligations.label: Exact generic Gaussian law under complementary covariance

bindings.boundary: Canonical prerequisite only. No paper-specific matrix square-root, tensor-slot adapter, noisy-center routine, query-invariance trace, recursive accuracy, query cap, or OAI/SPHMC main theorem.
